description: FK → Calendar Date Dimension — LOOKUP qua Calendar Date
etl_logic: LOOKUP cdr_dt_dim ON cdr_dt_dim.cdr_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt AND securities_trade.trade_dt = :etl_date

description: FK to Securities Dimension - LOOKUP qua Symbol (HOSE) hoac ISIN Code (HNX/UPCOM, vi securities_trade.security_symbol_code cua HNX la issue_code tho, khong phai ticker sach) - [SUA 2026-09-18, theo BA cap nhat join HNX-stockinfor: stockinfor.symbolisin = hnx.issue_code]
etl_logic: LOOKUP securities_dim ON securities_dim.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code OR securities_dim.isin_code = securities_trade.security_symbol_code

description: FK to Public Company Dimension (bang dung chung GSDC/QLCB/NDTNN) - LOOKUP qua ma CK sach (Equity Ticker Symbol), bac cau qua Securities Dimension da resolve dung ca HOSE/HNX - [SUA 2026-09-18] truoc day LOOKUP thang tu securities_trade.security_symbol_code, sai voi HNX (issue_code tho khong khop equity_ticker_symbol). nullable=true - khong phai moi ma CK deu la cong ty dai chung co Business Line (CW/derivative/ETF...)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN securities_dim ON (securities_dim.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code OR securities_dim.isin_code = securities_trade.security_symbol_code) → LOOKUP public_company_dim ON public_company_dim.equity_ticker_symbol = securities_dim.symbol

description: [SUA 2026-09-22, ra soat theo yeu cau Data Modeler doi chieu cau lenh tham khao BA STT1] Bo sung loc stock_tp_code IN ('1','2','3') qua Securities Dimension - truoc day thieu hoan toan, SUM tren ca chung khoan phai sinh/CW ngoai pham vi BA. [SUA 2026-09-22 lan 2, theo yeu cau Data Modeler - MAX(tradingtime) KHONG phai proxy 'ngay hien tai'] Bo sung dieu kien Securities Dimension.Trading Time = MAX(Trading Time) GROUP BY Stock Type Code - dung nguyen ban chat BA: chi tinh nhung ma CK con nam trong 'dot snapshot moi nhat' cua dung loai chung khoan cua no (loai ma bi stale/khong duoc cap nhat dong bo cung cac ma cung loai, VD ma tam dung GD/mat lien ket feed du van con ban ghi cu trong bang nguon). SUM Execution Value phía mua, lọc Foreign Investor Type Code <> '00' (khác '00' = có yếu tố nước ngoài) GROUP BY Trade Date + Symbol
etl_logic: INNER JOIN securities_dim ON (securities_dim.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code OR securities_dim.isin_code = securities_trade.security_symbol_code) AND securities_dim.stock_tp_code IN ('1','2','3') AND securities_dim.trading_time = (SELECT MAX(sd2.trading_time) FROM securities_dim sd2 WHERE sd2.stock_tp_code = securities_dim.stock_tp_code) → SUM(securities_trade.execution_val) WHERE securities_trade.buy_foreign_investor_tp_code <> '00' GROUP BY securities_trade.trade_dt, securities_trade.security_symbol_code
source_attribute: Execution Value / Buy Foreign Investor Type Code / Stock Type Code / Trading Time
